briefing_objective.text: Speak with the survivor and decide where to route the remaining power.

entry_door_objective.text: Open the service door into the security arena.

combat_threshold_objective.text: Enter the security arena and assess the locked far door.

recruitment_objective.text: Recruit the Protector waiting beyond the service junction.

destination_objective.text: Lead the party to the evacuation airlock.

dialogue.speaker: Survivor
dialogue.line: The reserve cell cannot hold both systems. We can power the service corridor, or keep the shelter seals stable.

responses.text: Reroute power to the service corridor. We need a clear route.
Keep the shelter sealed. We will take the corridor as it is.

interactions.result_text: The entry service door unlocks and slides open.

interactions.prompt: Open the arena exit service door
interactions.result_text: The arena exit unlocks after the security threat is cleared.

dialogue.speaker: Protector
dialogue.line: That airlock needs two people to cycle safely. I can cover your approach.

interactions.result_text: The terminal confirms full service-corridor power. Shelter seals are running on emergency reserve.
interactions.preserved_result_text: The terminal confirms stable shelter seals. The service corridor remains on intermittent emergency lighting.

interactions.result_text: The Protector secures the inner door and the evacuation airlock opens.
